newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's BTC suspended from trade for day.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's BTC suspended from trade for day.

text.p: Slovenian shopping centre operator BTC fell 3.29 percent in Tuesday's early trade before the bourse suspended trading in the share due to the firm's news conference regarding its listing abroad.

"According to the bourse regulations, trading in BTC was stopped due to its news conference in order to prevent the possibility of insider information," Lidija Gabrijelcic, spokeswoman of the Ljubljana bourse told Reuters.
She said the share will be excluded from trading until the end of today's trading session at 1100 GMT.
"Most likely BTC fell after yesterday's rumours on its global depository receipt (GDR) issue listing abroad failed to come true," said Jernej Zizek, a trader at A bank.
BTC, which completed a roadshow for the GDR issue last week is expected to list its GDRs on the London and New York bourses soon.
BTC would be the second Slovenian company to be listed abroad after Slovenia's second largest bank SKB.
Before the trading suspension, BTC fell 3.29 percent or 480 tolars to 14,120 tolars on volume of 158 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
